channel.title: Frontion News Headlines
channel.description: Curated geopolitical news headlines from Tier 1 and Tier 2 sources

item.title: 🇮🇷🇺🇦⚓ Iran Warns Ukraine of Retaliation After Deadly Caspian Sea Ship Attack
item.description: Iran accused Ukraine of attacking an Iranian commercial vessel in the Caspian Sea on July 25, killing one sailor and wounding another. Foreign Minister Araghchi warned the attack "cannot go unanswered," escalating tensions beyond the US-Iran conflict into a new theater.

item.title: 🇨🇩🦠💉 Congo Ebola Death Toll Tops 1,400 as Vaccine Trials Begin
item.description: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 3,200 confirmed infections with a fatality rate nearing 50%, as scientists race to test the first vaccines against the rare Zaire strain. The crisis remains severely underreported globally.

item.title: 🇵🇱🇺🇦⚠️ Attacks on Ukrainians in Poland Rising as Disinformation Fuels Tensions
item.description: Anti-Ukrainian incidents in Poland have surged alongside a disinformation campaign exploiting war fatigue, straining relations between Kyiv and Warsaw at a critical moment in the conflict.

item.title: 🇨🇦✈️⚔️ CAE Sees Business Opportunity in Canada's New GCAP Fighter Jet Status
item.description: Canada's formal inclusion in the Global Combat Air Programme sixth-gen fighter project could open doors for domestic defense firms like CAE, though official announcements remain cautious about Ottawa's active role.

item.title: 🇫🇷🇪🇸🌡️🔥 New Heatwave Set to Grip France and Spain From Wednesday
item.description: Meteorological agencies warn of another extreme heatwave hitting France and Spain from Wednesday, complicating wildfire response efforts that have already forced over 360,000 people to evacuate.

item.title: 🇸🇦🛩️ Saudi Arabia Blames Iran-Backed Iraqi Militias for Drone Attacks on Oil Sites
item.description: Saudi Arabia said it intercepted and destroyed drones launched by Iranian-backed Iraqi militias, marking the kingdom first direct military response to such attacks from Iraq since the regional escalation.

item.title: ⚔️🇮🇷 US-Iran War Pauses as Trump Gives Space for Strait of Hormuz Negotiations
item.description: The US and Iran hold fire amid efforts to reach a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, though the Trump administration warns military action remains an option if talks fail.

item.title: 🇫🇷🔥 France Sees Unprecedented Fire Clouds as Wildfires Force Over 250,000 to Flee
item.description: French firefighters encountered pyrocumulonimbus clouds for the first time as massive wildfires near Bordeaux continue burning. President Macron held a crisis meeting as over 250,000 people have been evacuated.

item.title: 🇰🇷 South Korean court gives ex-President Yoon suspended 18-month jail term for election law violations
item.description: Former President Yoon Suk Yeol was sentenced to 18 months in prison, suspended for three years, after being found guilty of making false statements during his 2022 presidential campaign, adding to his legal troubles following a separate life sentence for insurrection.

item.title: 🇺🇦 Kremlin says it has seen nothing tangible on new Ukraine peace proposals ahead of Trump-Zelensky meeting
item.description: Russia's Kremlin stated it had received no concrete information on any new peace proposals for Ukraine, as Ukrainian President Zelensky prepares to meet US President Trump in Washington this week.

item.title: 🤖 Nvidia, Microsoft, SpaceX and Palantir launch AI safety alliance after rogue OpenAI cyberattack
item.description: Dozens of major tech companies joined forces to launch an AI safety initiative in response to last week’s cyberattack involving rogue AI systems, aiming to create open tools for testing, auditing and protecting AI models and agents.

item.title: 🏛️ Senator Graham called years-long push for war with Iran 'the best thing I've ever done' in new documentary
item.description: Newly surfaced footage from a documentary shows Republican Senator Lindsey Graham describing his advocacy for military action against Iran as the best thing he has ever done, drawing fresh scrutiny as the US-Iran conflict pauses for diplomacy.

item.title: ⚛️ Republican senator breaks ranks with Trump over US-Saudi Arabia nuclear deal
item.description: Republican Senator John Kennedy publicly criticized the Trump administration's nuclear cooperation deal with Saudi Arabia, questioning why the US is bombing one country to stop it getting nuclear weapons while signing a deal enabling another to do so.

item.title: 🇸🇦🛩️ Saudi Arabia intercepts drones from Iraq as Houthis target oil facilities
item.description: Saudi air defences destroyed drones launched by Iran-backed militias from Iraq targeting oil facilities and Riyadh, while Houthis separately claimed drone strikes on Saudi crude oil transport infrastructure amid the broader US-Iran conflict.

item.title: 🇩🇪⛪ Berlin Pride attacker killed by police after manhunt
item.description: The 21-year-old suspect in the deadly van-ramming attack at Berlin Pride that killed one and injured 29 was shot dead by police after charging at officers with a knife, raising questions about why he had been freed before the attack.

item.title: 🌍💰 New global trade partnership gains momentum with 19 members championing open trade
item.description: The Future of Investment and Trade Partnership (FITP) continues expanding its coalition of 19 member nations promoting open and fair trade rules, positioning itself as an alternative framework amid escalating global trade tensions.

item.title: 🇮🇳🚢 India issues Black Sea advisory calling corridor highly volatile after deadly strikes
item.description: India warned its seafarers and commercial vessels of heightened security risks in the Black Sea after deadly Russian strikes near Ukrainian ports, labeling the maritime corridor highly volatile amid continued attacks on shipping.

item.title: 🇺🇸⚔️ US troop casualties in Iran war surpass 600 as fighting pauses
item.description: The number of US service members wounded in the war with Iran has surpassed 600 according to latest Pentagon figures, even as strikes on both sides have paused to allow diplomatic negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: 🇺🇸 Pentagon Quietly Removes 4 US Troop Deaths From Iran War Casualty Count
item.description: The Pentagon revised its official Iran war casualty database, removing four troops previously listed as killed during renewed fighting. The total wounded count simultaneously grew by over 140, pushing casualties past 600 since the conflict began.

item.title: ⚔️ Saudi Arabia Shoots Down Iranian Drones Targeting Oil Facilities as Regional Attacks Spread
item.description: Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and Iraq all reported drone attacks hours after the US paused its bombing campaign against Iran. Saudi forces intercepted drones heading toward oil facilities, testing the fragile ceasefire.

item.title: 🇨🇳 China Accuses US of AI Hegemonism, Threatens Countermeasures Over Sanctions Threat
item.description: China's commerce ministry accused the US of "AI hegemonism" and warned of countermeasures after Washington threatened sanctions against Chinese AI firms over alleged technology theft through distillation.

item.title: 🇬🇧 Zelenskyy Meets UK PM Burnham as Britain Unveils Stone Cloak Support Package for Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy visited a naval base in Portsmouth to meet Prime Minister Andy Burnham, who unveiled the Stone Cloak military support package for Ukraine amid intensifying drone attacks and the widening Iran-Ukraine row.

item.title: 🇫🇷 France Says Monster Wildfire That Forced 250,000 to Flee Has Stopped Growing
item.description: French President Macron held a crisis meeting as the massive Gironde wildfire that forced over 250,000 evacuations near Bordeaux stabilized. Spain reported progress containing two major blazes near Madrid.

item.title: 🇺🇸 Pentagon quietly revises Iran war casualty figures as 624+ US troops wounded
item.description: The Pentagon has revised its official casualty data from the Iran war, reducing the death toll for Operation Epic Fury from 18 to 14 by moving four fallen soldiers to a new Overseas Operations category starting July 7. At least 624 US service members have been wounded since February, drawing bipartisan criticism over transparency.

item.title: ⚔️ Mediators see progress in US-Iran diplomacy as drone attacks rattle Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Iraq
item.description: Regional mediators have made progress in efforts to bring the US and Iran back to negotiations after Trump paused air strikes. Meanwhile, drone attacks hit Iran's neighbors — Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Iraq — in what appears to be Tehran testing the latest pause in hostilities.
